purpose: Bounded behavior check of the preview.6 tracker-neutral wording (skill-evals.md: changed execution instructions need a check limited to the changed decisions). Not an adoption comparison and not an effect measurement.
evaluated_target: ko/adaptive-sdd at base_commit; identified by the MANIFEST.json sha256 recorded in results
selection_rule: Existing cases whose expected behavior touches an operation whose wording moved: work-item creation with Priority/grade values, Epic without a grade, the closing reference, product-complete on the declared merge target, and claim acquisition. Chosen before any run; not changed after runs start.
retry_policy: No automatic retry. An environment failure is INVALID, not FAIL.
isolation: Fresh disposable project per run, installed from the evaluated bundle with the example project.json and a local-docs tracker folder. No real tracker, remote or product data.
grading: Cross-graded with tests/run_behavior_evals.py: Claude answers graded by Codex, Codex answers graded by Claude.
known_limits: One run per case per agent: a smoke check of the changed wording, not a reliability estimate.
The runner installs a local-docs tracker, so the GitHub adapter rows are covered by static tests only.
The runner writes a fixed 'uncommitted preview.5 working tree' label into each result's commit field; base_commit and the manifest hash above identify the evaluated bundle.
